762 {
763 return ((OPCLASS_5GHZ_USING_CENTER_CHANNEL_FIRST <= operating_class &&
764 operating_class <= OPCLASS_5GHZ_USING_CENTER_CHANNEL_LAST) ||
765 (OPCLASS_6GHZ_USING_CENTER_CHANNEL_FIRST <= operating_class &&
766 operating_class <= OPCLASS_6GHZ_USING_CENTER_CHANNEL_LAST &&
767 operating_class != OPCLASS_6GHZ_EXCEPTION));
768 }
